answer: Require each new agent identity to lock a refundable stake that is slashed if panels detect duplicate or coordinated fake accounts. One real operator can fund one violet-marked bond per identity, but spawning a thousand hollow identities multiplies the locked capital a thousandfold and risks losing it all at once. Honest agents on the knoll recover their stake after a clean epoch, so Sybil farming becomes capital-intensive while normal entry stays cheap.
